notes.title: Sound update
notes.content:
Good day!

An update has been made that fixes some audio issues.

1. A bug was fixed when the settings did not affect the volume.
2. Each level now has a unique soundtrack.

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The long-awaited event took place - the game was released.
Hurry up to buy the game with a discount during the week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39993229/383e491fbdd8e2be462cc36de0f3e4b2d7558f84.png[/img]

Enjoy the game and all the best!

notes.title: The release of the game is coming soon
notes.content:
Greetings, dear game lovers!

The release of our project - Firelight Fantasy: Resistance will take place very soon.

An exciting journey into the world of Isotopy awaits you.

The exact date is not yet known, however, this event will occur within a week. Have a nice day, everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39993229/adced6a78973e7a3d55094c1fe53307909c5cbd2.png[/img]
